tool.name: foscat-synthesis
tool.description: Multi-scale scattering-transform synthesis (and gap-filling) of HEALPix maps and 2D images via FOSCAT

param.name: target_map
param.label: Target reference map (.npy). HEALPix: 1D (n_pixels,) or (1, n_pixels). 2D image: (H, W) or (1, H, W).

param.name: starting_map
param.label: Optional starting map (.npy, same shape as target). Leave unset to generate random noise scaled to the target's mean/std.

param.name: eval_mask
param.label: Optional evaluation mask (.npy, same shape as target). Restricts where the scattering statistics are computed (e.g. ocean-only). Leave unset to use all pixels.

param.name: update_mask
param.label: Optional update mask (.npy, same shape as target). Restricts which pixels the synthesis updates (e.g. cloudy regions only — for gap-filling). Leave unset to update all pixels.

param.name: norient
param.label: Number of orientations for the scattering transform (FOSCAT NORIENT)

param.name: kernelsz
param.label: Kernel size for the scattering transform (FOSCAT KERNELSZ)

param.name: seed
param.label: Random seed for the starting noise (used only when starting_map is empty)

param.name: do_lbfgs
param.label: Use L-BFGS optimizer (default). Uncheck to use FOSCAT's first-order fallback.

param.name: eval_frequency
param.label: Validation print frequency in iterations (0 = nsteps/10, the FOSCAT default)

tool.help:
# foscat-synthesis
Synthesise a map (or fill gaps in a map) so that its multi-scale scattering-transform statistics match a target reference, using [FOSCAT](https://github.com/jmdelouis/FOSCAT) (Delouis et al. 2022). It works on both **HEALPix** maps (1D arrays of length `12 * nside**2`) and **2D images** (any `(H, W)` grid), selected with the `domain` parameter.
The same algorithm covers two use cases, controlled by which optional masks are supplied:
- **Pure synthesis** — generate a new realisation with the same scattering statistics as a target (e.g. a cosmological large-scale-structure map or a natural-image texture). Provide only the target; synthesis starts from random noise scaled to the target's mean/std. - **Gap-filling** — replace masked regions of an observed map with values whose scattering statistics match a gap-free reference (e.g. cloudy SST pixels filled to match an L4 product). Supply the reference as `target_map`, the observed map as `starting_map`, an **evaluation mask** (where the reference statistics are computed) and an **update mask** (which pixels may change).
## Inputs
- **Target map** (`npy`) — HEALPix: 1D `(n_pixels,)` or `(1, n_pixels)`; 2D image: `(H, W)` or `(1, H, W)`. - **Starting map** (`npy`, optional) — same shape as the target. - **Evaluation mask** (`npy`, optional) — restricts where statistics are computed. - **Update mask** (`npy`, optional) — restricts which pixels the synthesis updates (FOSCAT `grd_mask`); use for gap-filling.
## Outputs
- **Synthesised map** (`npy`) — same shape as the target. - **Results** (JSON) — configuration plus the scattering-coefficient error before/after synthesis and an improvement summary.
